trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum is the sum of the whole list: earn the other 54 trophies and this one unlocks on its own. Work the roadmap in order — story first, then activities and collectibles, then the 100% cleanup — and the platinum is the last thing that pops. Everything is offline and single-player, so the whole list is doable solo.

roadmap.title: Story — Chapters 1 to 5
roadmap.text: Play the story straight through, chapters 1 to 5, and take every side-character strand as it opens. Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter and one before the final mission — there is no mission replay. Do the Chapter 1 meditation spot (Lucia's balcony) before Chapter 1 ends; it is the one missable. This stage earns the 17 story trophies and the gold for the final mission.

roadmap.title: Activities & side content
roadmap.text: With the map open, work the activities: 8 stranger strands, the 42 Shooting Range challenges (gold all of them), 14 drone races, 20 race wins, 250 stunts, 50 challenges, fishing against Cal, arcade, bowling, meditation at all 18 spots, the unique hunt for Bret, the 9 gang operations, the 5 bank vaults, and the partner wanted-level and robbery trophies. Try all 9 activity types for Master of None.

roadmap.title: Collectibles & economy
roadmap.text: Sweep the collectibles: 3 card sets, WAiNK check-ins at 100 spots, 100 vehicles discovered, all 52 areas explored, all 8 garages bought, 10 vehicles registered to Scooter Bros. Keep laundering Marked Bills ($250,000) and spending in shops ($100,000) as you go — the money trophies finish themselves if you launder and shop steadily.

roadmap.title: Cleanup & platinum
roadmap.text: Check the in-game 100% list and clear the last categories for A Long Road (gold). Once the 100% gold pops, the only thing left is the platinum itself — it unlocks the moment the other 54 are done.
